known_issues.issue: Pygame dependency build failure on Windows
known_issues.description: uv sync fails to build pygame from source due to missing MSYS2 and build dependencies
known_issues.workaround: Pre-built pygame was installed via parent venv using 'uv pip install --python'
known_issues.impact: Application requires manual dependency setup before running with 'uv run python main.py'

conclusion.summary: The Vector Brick Stacker Gravity Balance game successfully launches and runs. The code structure is well-organized with clear separation of concerns. Physics engine implements proper collision detection using SAT algorithm. AI interface provides observation and step methods for reinforcement learning. The main issue is the pygame dependency setup on Windows, which requires manual installation of pre-built wheels.
recommendations: Update pyproject.toml to specify pre-built wheel installation for pygame on Windows
Consider adding a setup script to handle pygame installation automatically
Add error handling for pygame initialization failure

functionality_verified: Physics engine (center of mass calculation, SAT collision)
